paths.title: Yoga basics (30 days)
paths.subtitle: Take the easiest lesson of the French course

tasks.title: Set your intention
tasks.description: Pick a consistent time and space for practice. Do 3 minutes of mindful breathing, then a gentle stretch.

tasks.title: Sun salutations (easy pace)
tasks.description: Practice 3–5 rounds of a slow sun salutation. Focus on smooth inhales and exhales rather than depth.

tasks.title: Hips + hamstrings
tasks.description: Hold a forward fold and a seated stretch for 30–45 seconds each. Keep your spine long and avoid pushing into pain.

tasks.title: Balance basics
tasks.description: Try tree pose for 3 rounds per side. Use a wall or chair for support and keep your gaze steady.

tasks.title: Recovery flow
tasks.description: Do a short restorative sequence: child's pose, cat-cow, and a 2-minute savasana. Notice how your body feels.

paths.title: French starter (90 days)
paths.subtitle: Take the easiest lesson of the French course

tasks.title: Greetings + pronunciation
tasks.description: Learn 5 greetings and say them out loud. Record yourself once and compare to the audio.

tasks.title: Numbers 1–20
tasks.description: Practice counting 1–20 twice. Then write the numbers 1–10 from memory.

tasks.title: Basic introductions
tasks.description: Build 3 short sentences: name, where you're from, and how you're doing. Say them without reading.

tasks.title: Common phrases
tasks.description: Memorize 6 phrases (please/thanks/sorry/excuse me). Use each one in a simple sentence.

tasks.title: Mini review
tasks.description: Review days 1–4. Do a quick self-test: speak your greetings and numbers, then write 3 intro sentences.
